PRIVACY & DISCLOSURES

Clarity builds
trust.

A straightforward overview of this website’s contact tools and the separate services featured here.

Using the contact page

The contact form prepares a message in your browser. It does not submit your entries to a website database. Selecting “Open email draft” passes the message to your email application. You review and send it there. When you send an email to Greg, the email and any information you include are handled by the email providers involved.

Information you choose to share

Keep general inquiries brief. Do not include Social Security numbers, account numbers, credentials, medical information or sensitive financial documents. Request an appropriate channel directly if your conversation requires sensitive information.

External destinations

This site links to Greg’s WFG profile, LinkedIn and the Academy’s Skool page. Those services have their own privacy notices, terms and data practices. Any forms, booking requests or memberships on those destinations are handled there.

Site technology

This portfolio does not add advertising trackers, analytics scripts or marketing cookies. Its hosting provider may process ordinary technical request information to serve the website. The site’s contact form does not use persistent browser storage. No financial transactions are conducted through this portfolio.

Separate areas of work

CRM consulting, financial services and community coaching are distinct activities. Financial products and services are subject to the relevant company requirements, licensing and geographic availability. Review the entity details and disclosures on Greg’s official WFG profile. This website does not provide tax, legal or individualized investment advice. Community coaching content is for personal development and is not clinical care.

Professional information

Professional and educational background is based on Greg’s existing published profile and website. Historical professional references are linked on the Experience page and do not imply endorsement of current services.

Contact

For a question about information on this website, contact gregorydenizard@gmail.com.
